methodology.rankings: Official ICORE 2026 classifications where verified. Estimated visibility is qualitative and is not mapped to CORE or to journal quartiles.
methodology.forecasts: Windows pool the observed submission/conference months; single-edition estimates allow one extra month on either side. Sparse data use explicitly documented seasonal or 2–5-month lead-time assumptions. Biennial cycles are preserved. Estimates are not deadline guarantees.

history_note: Historical coverage is incomplete. Missing editions do not imply that an event was not held. Unverified historical deadlines are left unknown. The ICORE 2026 badge describes the current conference family, not its historical rank.
